card.fact_statement: The Huawei Mate 70 Pro+ features a main 50 MP RYYB sensor.
card.source_span: There are three cameras on the back of the Mate 70 Pro+: a main 50 MP RYYB sensor with a 24 mm variable f/1.4-f/4.0 aperture lens.
